summary: pmcro-trail:initialize's link path (an existing --trail-id supplied to orchestrate run) has no deterministic script of its own -- New-Trail.ps1 only implements mint and explicitly rejects an already-existing trail. Orchestrator's New-OrchestrateFrame.ps1 covers claiming/verifying a trail is open and unclaimed, but nothing verifies it was actually materialized by pmcro-trail's own initialize contract. Give pmcro-trail a real link-path script (or an -Link mode on New-Trail.ps1) so that half of its own command contract isn't still aspirational.
